title: Restore the previous authorized Work Queue page without resetting the analyst's position
goal: Complete bounded bidirectional navigation for existing native CAP-CMD-101 six-view Work Queue, preserving manual filters and chronological sort while reauthorizing every page.
invariants: One canonical GET /command/work-queue, same six Command system views, no separate page or new route.
Every page is recalculated with a fresh host session and full bounded Owner.List and Owner.CanRead for each in-scope Incident and Task before any cursor is accepted.

Previous cursor is derived from the same authorized page digest and tenant/environment/principal/view/status/sort as the existing next cursor; no new ACL model, raw IDs or source contents are encoded.
Page 2 goes back to the first page without a fabricated start=0 cursor; subsequent pages link to the immediately preceding 50 rows, not an unrelated or stale snapshot.
Per-page selection remains limited to freshly authorized visible rows; revoked/stale cursor is denied generically with no partial results.
Base PR #165 HEAD fbdfefe9a19d1fc6693e7e53b2649c59a2c18284 is frozen; Git parent is not engineering parent.
security_properties: No consumer receives permissions from a cursor; each request performs server authorization anew.
After an ACL or scope change, a previous-page token has exactly the same revocation and generic 404 behavior as a next-page token.
No access to cross-tenant owner identifiers, no denied source row or owner value in cursors, HTML links or results.

migration.rationale: Backward-compatible optional previous_cursor JSON field and native previous-page link; no DB, new request flags or persisted schema.

rollback.strategy: Remove optional previous_cursor and prior-page link while retaining existing forward cursor and permissions.
verification: Forward 50-row pagination, filters/sort and selection preserve existing tests
No new host Owner calls or route

inputs: Canonical CAP-CMD-101 §§3,11,16,17,21,25; Incident and Task object ownership, canonical pagination, tenant and permission contracts.
Verified GitHub PR #165 HEAD fbdfefe9a19d1fc6693e7e53b2649c59a2c18284, 12 commits, exact-head CI both success, parent task E10-CMD-101G-PAGE IMPLEMENTED.
Existing first-party authorizedQueuePage and native Work Queue HTML; no final Shared cursor standard is claimed.
outputs: From page N>=3, return to exact page N-1 with same authorized filtered/sorted row projection; from page 2 return to original first page.
Safe native previous/first/next links and optional previous_cursor response with unchanged per-request owner ACL.
acceptance_tests: Three-page 123 authorized, denied and foreign Task fixture round trip 50→50→23→50→50, accurate indices and no cross-tenant CanRead.
Fresh owner session and 124 in-scope owner ACL checks for each visited page; stale previous token denied after revocation.
Native prior-page href preserves view/status/sort and escapes URL/context; selecting off-page or revoked row remains denied through existing tests.
Exact SHA Linux/macOS/Windows work-queue and engineering-kernel CI gates including mandatory changed-security critical 90%.

performance_budget.rationale: No extra owner reads beyond one existing O(n) bounded per-page full owner projection plus SHA256; at most 5000 candidates, 50 returned.
metrics: One owner.List and same per-object CanRead on every page
No extra digest pass or external service
